'''Faye Mata''' is an American actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Faye’s first role in the {{pkmn|animated series}} was in {{aniseries|JN}}, where she voiced a [[character of the day]], [[Devi and Multa|Multa]]. She eventually got the role of [[Dot]] for {{aniseries|HZ}}.
